name: @w6w-apps/hex
description: Run Hex projects, poll or cancel runs, and read projects, users, groups, collections and data connections.

w6w.longDescription:
Hex is a collaborative analytics workspace where notebooks and data apps run SQL and Python against a team's warehouse. This app lets a workflow trigger a published Hex project on demand, hand it input parameters, poll the run until it reaches a terminal state, and cancel it if it should not finish.

Around that core it reads the workspace itself: projects and their metadata, the runs of each project filtered by status or trigger, the warehouse tables a project queries, and the users, groups, collections and data connections that organise access.

A run always executes the latest published version of a project and answers with a run handle rather than a result, so a workflow starts a run, polls its status, and reads results where the project publishes them. Health checks track Hex's status page, reading the components the API and runs depend on.
